name: Grok chat (sandbox shell, no MCP client)

wire.verify: Grok chat drives a Linux sandbox from a shell with no MCP client: there is nothing to wire. The 2026-09-21 field run installed from the registry and minted through `npx mojulo call`. This profile exists so `MOJULO_HOST=grok-chat` resolves a door table for the handoff note; init never detects it.

manual: No MCP client here — skip init. npm install mojulo, then: npx mojulo call <tool> --json '{…}' (export_model with format 'html' or 'bundle'; files are the whole handoff).
